title: More than 114K Britax car seats recalled over handle defect - ABC7 Bay Area
text:
Britax recalls more than 114K car seats over handle defect - ABC7 San Francisco 
 24/7 Live San Francisco East Bay South Bay Peninsula North Bay Recall 
 More than 114K Britax car seats recalled over handle defect 
 The car seats' carrying handle may cause the child to fall. 
 The car seats' carrying handle may cause the child to fall, according to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. GMA By Ayesha Ali Friday, August 28, 2026 Share More than 114,000 child car seats sold by Britax are being recalled, according to a notice from the National Highway Transportation Safety Administration.
 The impacted car seats have a screw in the seat's carrying handle that may come loose, "causing the handle to partially detach," according to the NHTSA.
 "A child may fall after a partial detachment, increasing the risk of injury," the NHTSA states.
 The recall, first posted online on Aug. 20, includes certain B-Safe Gen 2, B-Safe Gen 2 Flexfit, B-Safe Gen 2 Flexfit Plus, B-Safe 35, B-Safe Ultra, and Endeavours child seats.

 A remedy for the defect is currently under development and impacted car seat owners will be mailed recall notices October 19, according to the NHTSA.
 The agency said owners of the recalled car seats may also contact Britax customer service at 888-427-4829.
 ABC News has reached out to Britax for comment.
